Package parking.domain.model

Class RateWithDailyCap

java.lang.Object
parking.domain.model.RateWithDailyCap
All Implemented Interfaces:
Rate
public class RateWithDailyCap extends Object implements Rate
Rate decorator (Decorator pattern) that applies a maximum amount per 24-hour period once the stay reaches a configured minimum number of hours.

This class is the single place where the "daily cap" business rule lives. It wraps any other Rate (typically an HourlyRate) without that base rate needing to know about caps at all. As a consequence, the rule can evolve - a different threshold, a different cap amount, or even a new decorator stacked on top of this one - without touching Vehicle, ParkingTicket, or the application's use cases.

    • RateWithDailyCap

      public RateWithDailyCap(Rate baseRate, long minHoursToApplyCap, long capAmountPerPeriod)
      Creates a rate that caps a base rate's result per 24-hour period.
      Parameters:
      baseRate - the rate whose result this decorator caps
      minHoursToApplyCap - minimum number of billable hours at which the cap starts to apply; stays shorter than this are charged at baseRate with no cap
      capAmountPerPeriod - maximum amount chargeable per each complete or partial 24-hour period

  • Method Details

    • calculateAmount

      public long calculateAmount(long minutesStayed)
      Calculates the amount that must be charged for a given stay.

      Delegates to the wrapped baseRate for the raw amount and, only when the stay is long enough, compares it against the daily cap for the corresponding number of 24-hour periods, returning whichever amount is lower.

      Specified by:
      calculateAmount in interface Rate
      Parameters:
      minutesStayed - total minutes the vehicle remained parked
      Returns:
      the amount to charge, in the currency's smallest common accounting unit used throughout the system (colones, no decimals)
